name: dcmnorm
description: Read, inspect, edit, anonymize, validate, transcode and render DICOM medical images with the dcmnorm CLI, and query, send and receive them over a DICOM network (PACS) with dcmtalk. Installs the native CLIs from PyPI on first use; everything runs locally.
suggestedPrompts: Show the patient, study and series details of this DICOM file
Render every frame of this DICOM file to PNG
Check whether my PACS at host:port answers a C-ECHO
